missing-piece.title: The Missing Piece
missing-piece.lead: Everyone is talking about Israel. There’s just one question they forgot to ask.
missing-piece.note: The first class is yours to try, commitment-free.
missing-piece.bar: Six Wednesdays from Jan 20 · 11:00 am or 7:00 pm · Jewish Federation or Zoom

about.lead: Why is Judaism so attached to one slice of the earth’s crust?
text: This six-part course goes beyond the headlines, politics, and modern history to understand why the Land of Israel matters as much as it does. Once you understand the root of the Jewish people’s bond with the Land of Israel, the answers to the biggest questions about Israel today snap into place.

lessons.title: A Holy Land
lessons.text: The world can’t look away from a country the size of New Jersey. The reason starts with the word “holy.”

lessons.title: A Chosen Land
lessons.text: Jews are the people of the Book. So why a land? Moses’s spies had their doubts. So did Albert Einstein.

lessons.title: A Jewish Land
lessons.text: Can Israel be both a Jewish state and a democracy? See Judaism’s surprising case against religious coercion.

lessons.title: Whose Land Is It?
lessons.text: Where does the Jewish claim to Israel really begin? Israel’s founders left the strongest answer out.

lessons.title: Defending the Land
lessons.text: Strike first? Ceasefire? Land for peace? One principle guides Judaism’s approach to them all: the worth of a human life.

lessons.title: A Nation That Dwells Alone
lessons.text: No country is watched more closely or judged more harshly. What does that mean for those of us who live an ocean away?

teacher.name: Rabbi Levi Dubov
teacher.text: A world-class teacher and national speaker, with a Tanya podcast heard in 95 countries. His courses make deep ideas clear, in a room of people you’ll look forward to seeing.
teacher.photoAlt: Rabbi Levi Dubov teaching a full JLI class

faq: Do I need any background?
None at all. Everything is taught in English from a textbook written for adults coming to these sources for the first time.
Is this a political course?
No. It presents classical Jewish sources and uses them to explore questions that also touch public life today.
Can I join on Zoom?
Yes. Choose in person or Zoom when you register.
What if I miss a class?
Missing one will not leave you lost. Let us know and we will make sure you have the material before the next session.
What if the cost is difficult right now?
Please still come. Speak to us privately and we will work something out. Nobody is turned away over tuition.

kabbalah.title: Kabbalah and the Hidden Architecture of You
kabbalah.lead: Reincarnation, soulmates, dreams, names: what these and other mysteries reveal about the hidden design of your life.

text: Join this six-week course on concepts from kabbalah and how they come together to answer some of life’s biggest questions. Discover the mystical backstory that explains the mysteries you never understood about yourself, from your taste in music to your dreams, recurring challenges, soulmate, and life’s mission.

facts: Tuesdays 11:00 am · Wednesdays 11:00 am or 7:00 pm

lessons.title: Echoes of Your Soul in Everyday Life
lessons.text: Why do you like that song? Why did you marry that one? Where does your soul go when you sleep? Why do you dream? Do animals have souls?

lessons.title: Traces of the Sefirot in Your Body and Soul
lessons.text: What are the sefirot and how are they relevant to your life? Why do you have ten fingers? Is G-d’s name written on your body?

lessons.title: The Mystical Backstory of Your Soul
lessons.text: What’s the secret behind your preferences in food and music? What is reincarnation? Why do you keep facing the same struggle? What did your soul come here to do?

lessons.title: Signals from Heaven in Your Daily Life
lessons.text: Can someone else’s soul join yours? Who really chose your name? Why do you sometimes wake up inspired? Why does that person’s flaw bother you?

lessons.title: The Ripples of Your Thoughts and Words
lessons.text: Can your thoughts reach someone far away? Do words affect the people you talk about? Can positive thinking change your reality?

lessons.title: How You Can Touch Infinity in a Finite World
lessons.text: What’s the secret behind G-d’s many names? Where in my life can I touch Divine infinity? If G-d already decided, why pray?

about.lead: Every life is a story unfolding, but not every story is fully understood.
text: The early narratives of Genesis emerge not as distant beginnings but as a living reflection of the human soul. Through stories of longing and choice, fracture and renewal, discover a more intimate understanding of yourself, your purpose, and the path unfolding before you.
